comment: Four of the six jacks are unnamed in the source and show no tooltip: the X, Y and Z jacks and the freeze jack. The panel letters them X, Y, Z, a snowflake, V/OCT and TRIG. The default expressions on a fresh module are 0 for j, k, l and the time warp, 0.0039 for the attack, 0.5 for the decay, i*f for the pitch, 1/i*e for the amplitude and 1 for the phase; a phase expression of exactly 0 stops the phase being reset on a trigger. The seed knob is only acted on when it is above 1000, which is everywhere but its far left position. The X, Y and Z jacks and the pitch jack are only sampled on the slow tick, so they are not audio rate; the Quality menu item sets how often that tick happens.
